328526.title: Caporossi–Cioabă–Gutman–Hansen conjecture on minimum-energy connected graphs
328526.assessment: Energy minimization over connected graphs for an edge interval. Bipartite cases do not settle the nonbipartite minimizer; no exact lower-energy witness established. Literal only.

328559.title: Ratner's non-divergence conjecture for unipotent flows
328559.assessment: Non-divergence for arbitrary discrete subgroups needs quantitative recurrence on homogeneous spaces; epsilon quantifier absent from normalized wording. No exploit of missing quantifier.

328602.title: Homological critical-probability conjecture for hyperbolic percolation
328602.assessment: Equality of percolation and limiting homological thresholds requires both infinite-volume constructions and rank-difference semantics. No finite-test reduction.

328626.title: Unit-circle roots conjecture for the Goldbach polynomials
328626.assessment: Exact unit-circle root count for prime-indicator polynomials strengthens Goldbach. Divisibility supplies only lower bound, not absence of further boundary roots. No full route.

328630.title: Cycle-count conjecture for degree 3-critical graphs
328630.assessment: Distinct cycle-length count is asymptotic with an O(1) allowance. A small graph cannot refute it. Need an infinite family defeating the leading constant.

328638.title: Threshold conjecture for the index of squarefree powers of edge ideals
328638.assessment: Public 2021 Matchings and squarefree powers of edge ideals explicitly gives connected and disconnected nu0-counterexamples (Figures1,2); publisher primary search body excerpt inspected, full proof not audited. Do not formalize as new.

328705.title: A linear bound for real critical points of Fermat hypersurfaces
328705.assessment: SURVIVING COMPLETE FORMAL CANDIDATE: 153 rational nonzero real critical points for n17,d3,u all2; full critical set finite. Source pp4,6-7 and proof Theorem2.13 inspected; p7 rendered. Lean Fermat.claim_false, source quantifier distinction documented.

328709.title: Articulated Zilber-Pink conjecture for mixed Shimura and semi-abelian varieties
328709.assessment: Defect-by-defect unlikely intersections assertion. Ordinary Zilber-Pink implication is not an unconditional proof. No full special-subvariety semantics available.

328710.title: Defect condition for mixed Shimura varieties and weakly special subvarieties
328710.assessment: Record explicitly lacks definition of defect condition. No conclusion from the label or elementary dimension inequalities; requires source reconstruction.

328743.title: Balogh–Barát–Gerbner–Gyárfás–Sárközy cycle-partition conjecture
328743.assessment: Dense two-color cycle partition threshold: asymptotic slack cannot settle exact bound; cycle conventions must include degenerate cycles. No small-case loophole used.

328755.title: Open Virasoro conjecture for the full open partition function
328755.assessment: Open Virasoro constraints likely have substantial subsequent open-intersection literature, not screened in primary bodies here. No novelty clearance; infinite operator identities not formalized.

328760.title: Oblak's recursive conjecture for generic commuting nilpotent Jordan types
328760.assessment: Record explicitly flags subsequent work on Oblak recursion. Maximum-U-chain implementation alone would not establish equality with generic Jordan type. No prior-art clearance.

328869.title: The intermediate-word length conjecture for K-Knuth equivalent tableaux
328869.assessment: K-Knuth connectivity needs a path through words bounded by maximum tableau size, not merely endpoint insertion equivalence. No constructive path theorem.

328876.title: The treewidth upper-bound conjecture for line graphs
328876.assessment: Read Conjecture5.2 and Proposition5.3 tree-decomposition proof. Trees satisfy it publicly; singleton/edgeless negative RHS is a prohibited endpoint correction. General half-factor decomposition remains unproved.

328878.title: The algebraic-curve conjecture for functions over finite fields
328878.assessment: Finite-field moment invariant and low-degree curve assertion have missing epsilon/t hypotheses. No use of unrestricted t or moment-index typography to manufacture refutation.

328899.title: McDiarmid–Mohar conjecture on acyclic chromatic number of oriented graphs
328899.assessment: Asymptotic acyclic coloring logarithmic improvement: no finite-oriented-graph test settles O-bound. Need uniform coloring method.

328900.title: Extension of the McDiarmid–Mohar bound to m-degenerate chromatic number
328900.assessment: m-degenerate extension includes uniformity of constant and asymptotic ratio. Cases m1 and bounded degree cannot resolve full assertion.

328910.title: The generalized-star path-packing conjecture in hypercubes
328910.assessment: P_j indexing and generalized-star paths not specified by record. Requires primary definitions before numerical interpretation; no claimed witness.

328945.title: The rectilinear crossing-number formula for complete tripartite graphs
328945.assessment: Rectilinear tripartite crossing expression A is source-defined; no implementation of A or certified drawing enumeration. Parameter cases do not count.

328946.title: The crossing-number equality conjecture for complete tripartite graphs
328946.assessment: All tripartite sizes require optimum among arbitrary topological drawings versus straight drawings, not a finite diagram comparison. No full route.

328947.title: Xu's polynomial-time conjecture for the maximum forcing number of elementary polyominoes
328947.assessment: Normalized literal record already says primary paper proves polynomial algorithm via Clar number. Excluded on reported public resolution, body not independently audited.

328951.title: Equitable induced-forest partition conjecture for bounded-degree graphs
328951.assessment: Equitable vertex-arboricity bound needs simultaneous balance and forest structure at every k. Standard greedy degeneracy does not provide equitability.

328977.title: de Freitas–Nikiforov–Patuzzi conjecture on the Q-index of graphs forbidding even cycles
328977.assessment: Normalized literal record explicitly says its own paper completes proof of both assertions. Excluded on reported public resolution; no body audit claimed.

328993.title: Continuity of the connective constant under local convergence
328993.assessment: Infinite transitive local-convergence connective constants require global self-avoiding-walk lower semicontinuity. Local finite path counts give only one semicontinuity direction.

329057.title: Non-realizability of powers of the exceptional 2-pairing
329057.assessment: Exceptional paired Jacobian realization is sensitive to pairing rather than group alone. Cyclic wording may be corrupt; no group-order-only counterexample.

329059.title: The lower-order finite p-group cycle map conjecture
329059.assessment: Chow-to-cohomology injection for all small p-groups. A single cohomology computation without cycle-class semantic bridge would be insufficient.

329061.title: Existence of a subforest preserving game chromatic number
329061.assessment: Read game definition, trunk simulation Lemmas1-3 and Theorem4 proof, Lemma27/Theorem28 proof, Conjecture29. Pruning high-degree leaves does not transfer Bob strategies: outside moves consume turns and neighbor colors. Need local strategy-preserving reduction, not existence elsewhere of a subcubic chi4 tree.

329107.title: Full $L^2$-Alexander torsion conjecture for monodromy dilatation
329107.assessment: Torsion transition endpoint involves entropy and normalization, not Alexander polynomial alone. No finite spectral substitute or exact source torsion construction.

329174.title: General upper-bound conjecture for interval cyclic colorings
329174.assessment: Primary concluding Conjecture inspected; full coloring-bound proof not reviewed. General cyclic interval-color count has substantial later literature; no certified graph/coloring witness.

329259.title: Conjecture on the six smallest inversion numbers
329259.assessment: Read Conjecture2.7, inversion definitions and reciprocity induction proof Proposition2.6. Exact recurrence diagnostic finds no distinct-value violation through b300. Ranking multiplicities creates spurious violations because inverse a gives repeated values; not counted. Rank-transfer induction remains missing.

329260.title: Alon–Frankl conjecture on comparable pairs above the square-root threshold
329260.assessment: Normalized statement explicitly says source abstract resolves displayed Alon-Frankl conjecture. Excluded as reported known, without inflating body coverage.

329332.title: Universal upper bound conjecture for slack matrices of polygons
329332.assessment: Universal equality for any polygon differs from generic-polygon experimental motivation. Regular low-extension-complexity examples only expose wording/genericity and known extension constructions; prohibited as discovery.

329344.title: Maximum-transcendentality conjecture for loop amplitudes
329344.assessment: Weight bounds for arbitrary loop amplitudes need definitions of periods/weight and scheme; no mathematical endpoint reconstructed.

329418.title: Garijo et al.'s locating-dominating set conjecture for twin-free graphs
329418.assessment: Twin-free locating domination n/2 bound: arbitrary twin-free graph search would require exhaustive locating-set certificate, but no structural obstruction identified. No claim of current open status.

329425.title: Conjecture on the largest prime divisor of rank-proportion denominators
329425.assessment: PRIMARY RESOLVES: arXiv1412.2796v2 pp25-27 explicitly proves Conjecture5.1. Read Lemma5.4 integration-by-parts, Lemma5.5 inductive degree/denominator control, final proof using c_k integral. Exact bound 2^(k+1)+1 follows without new deduction.

329433.title: Cubic prime-divisor conjecture for sparsely Schemmel totient numbers
329433.assessment: Source defines P1 as LARGEST prime divisor (p8), normalized record says smallest. Read Definition1.1, Lemma3.5 and Corollary3.2 proof/Conjecture3.2 pp11-12. Do not turn smallest/largest corruption into claimed new solution. True largest-prime cubic bound remains unproved here.

329462.title: Disjointness minimizes the number of simultaneous splitters
329462.assessment: Primary Lemma4.8 already supplies unsplittable triangle. Splittable overlap example B1={1,2},B2={2,3},B3={1,3,4} has16 splitters on[7], versus24 for disjoint sizes2,2,3. Later Coskey et al.2022 section4/AppendixA already computes near-unsplittable minimum configurations through k60, including small structure. Excluded; no formalization spent on public/subsumed result.

329469.title: The generic-and-Hilton–Milner obstruction conjecture for EKR in random hypergraphs
329469.assessment: Random EKR assertion uses source-specific Lambda and uniform asymptotics. No finite small hypergraph refutation can bypass almost-sure hypotheses.

329484.title: The folklore sup-norm conjecture for newforms with mildly ramified central character
329484.assessment: Automorphic sup-norm bound is epsilon-uniform over newforms with conductor restriction. No exact finite-dimensional substitution; local obstruction alone not full conjecture.

329486.title: Cavers et al.'s maximum skew-spectral radius conjecture for odd-cycle graphs
329486.assessment: Title and literal statement already report Solution to a conjecture. Excluded as reported source resolution; no primary proof audit claimed.
